title: P6-04: Pilobol.us: copy the content cross-account, prove fidelity, point the new reader at the new backend, byte parity
description:
## Goal
The new Pilobol.us staging site (drafts shown to editors only) works on the stack-created staging branch of the new CMS app, still without a custom domain.

## Context (FACT)
- Git ref `staging` already exists on AnthusAI/Pilobol.us. The stack creates the Amplify branch `staging` (BETA, SITE_ENV staging, PAPYRUS_STAGING_PREVIEW, NEXT_PUBLIC_PAPYRUS_STAGING_URL); the console connect step must be repeated for it and may strip its env vars and buildSpec again.
- Open legacy defects that must be fixed and released first: PPY-35a1fb (staging preview route 403 StorageError on preview/*, root-mounted newsroom leaves / ungated while middleware rewrites it to /__preview) and PPY-cb27a6 (staging build cannot find amplify_outputs.json). Do not claim the gate on the new account until these are green on legacy staging too.
- preview/ objects are regenerated by the staging build/upload-preview, not copied.

## Exact steps
1. Confirm PPY-35a1fb and PPY-cb27a6 are closed and released; bump the pin on AnthusAI/Pilobol.us if needed (PR).
2. Console: connect the `staging` branch of the new CMS app; repair env vars and buildSpec if needed (stack update with PAPYRUS_STACK_REAPPLY=1 then without).
3. Start the staging job; poll to SUCCEED.
4. Checks on `https://staging.<newCmsAppId>.amplifyapp.com`: `node scripts/check-staging-guards.mjs <url> staging` (Papyrus repo); anonymous GET redirects to sign-in without a loop; X-Robots-Tag noindex,nofollow and robots disallow; editor sees a draft and Preview works; non-editor gets 403; the draft is absent from production; the main branch has no SITE_ENV staging, PAPYRUS_STAGING_PREVIEW or drafts variable (names only).

## Acceptance checks
- All guard checks pass on the new staging URL; legacy staging.pilobol.us untouched.

## Rollback
Delete the staging branch from the stack (site.json staging false, stack update).

## Needs Ryan
Console sitting for the staging branch, editor and non-editor sign-ins, Preview check.

## Common rules (Phase 6, PPY-7d8cd0)
- Read /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus/AGENTS.local.md first. Assert the account with `aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text` before EVERY call: profile legacy = 335163751677, profile papyrus-production = 712236451410. Never use papyrus-development; papyrus-staging (494166748521) is not used by this phase.
- Every write needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step. Legacy is READ-ONLY except the steps this ticket names (each with a yes). No SCPs on legacy; never risk legacy access; no `cdk deploy` and no `ampx` against the legacy stacks of these sites.
- Never print secret values (names only; SSM values move by pipe, never to the terminal or a ticket). Ryan deletes retired resources. Do not touch Anth.us production d2hbn1ig6nqyhy or the other anth.us apps (apricity d2n7w4kwqyfwn4, babulus d3epcqvzbxdaq, tactus dfkbdffs2viq8, primus divicqm3nhcwt).
- Baselines and scratch live under /Users/home/Projects/.baselines/phase6-<date>/ (outside any repo); clones go under /Users/home/Projects/ and are deleted afterwards (disk is tight). Only kbs writes in the Papyrus checkout (never git add/commit there); never `git stash`.
- The committed infra/site.json in each site repo still describes the LEGACY stack until the cutover ticket; production deploys use an out-of-repo, domain-free copy (as PPY-aa93b3 did for p.apyr.us).
right_now_summary: The new staging branch awaits setup, content verification, and guard checks before editors can review drafts.
